note: Owlry's Council test questions. Drafted scenarios, not verbatim customer messages. The category and label describe the problem for the record; only the text is ever sent to a worker, and the judge sees neither. Add questions at the end of a category with a new id; never reuse or renumber an id.

categories.Health: Care for your body, mind, and everyday wellbeing.
categories.Wealth: Navigate money, work, and financial freedom.
categories.Love: Build connection and navigate the relationships that matter.
categories.Purpose: Discover what matters and shape a life that feels yours.
categories.Wonder: Explore ideas, science, art, and the magic of stories.

questions.label: Exercise with constraints
questions.text: My shifts change every week, and I keep giving up on exercise. How can I build a routine that doesn’t depend on having the same schedule?

questions.label: Sleep and persistent symptoms
questions.text: I sleep around eight hours but still wake up exhausted. Is there something I should change, or should I get checked?

questions.label: Affordable nutrition
questions.text: I live alone, don’t enjoy cooking, and have a small grocery budget. What’s a realistic way to eat better?

questions.label: Skincare troubleshooting
questions.text: I started three new skincare products last week and now my face stings. How do I figure out what’s causing it?

questions.label: Pain and activity
questions.text: My knee hurts after running, but I’m training for my first race. Should I keep going, change my training, or stop?

questions.label: Emotional wellbeing
questions.text: I can’t switch off after work. I keep replaying conversations and worrying I’ve done something wrong. What would actually help?

questions.label: Menstrual health
questions.text: My periods have become much heavier and I’m tired all the time. Is that normal, and what should I ask a doctor?

questions.label: Conflicting health claims
questions.text: Everyone online says I need magnesium, collagen, and probiotics. How do I work out whether I need any supplements?

questions.label: Preparing for consultation
questions.text: My doctor recommended a treatment, but I’m worried about side effects. What questions would help me understand my options?

questions.label: Urgent ambiguity
questions.text: My chest feels tight and I’m lightheaded right now. I’ve been stressed lately—is it probably just anxiety?

questions.label: Irregular income
questions.text: I freelance, so some months are great and others are almost empty. How do I budget when I don’t know what I’ll earn?

questions.label: Competing financial priorities
questions.text: I have $3,000 saved and $2,000 in credit-card debt at 22% interest. Should I pay it off or keep the money for emergencies?

questions.label: Career tradeoff
questions.text: I got an offer that pays 25% more, but the commute would be 90 minutes each way. How do I decide whether it’s worth it?

questions.label: Salary negotiation
questions.text: I found out a colleague with similar responsibilities earns more than me. How can I ask for a raise without making the conversation about them?

questions.label: Career transition
questions.text: I want to leave teaching for a different career, but I can’t afford to stop earning or take another degree. How do I explore realistic options?

questions.label: Starting a business
questions.text: People keep telling me to sell my handmade jewelry. How can I test whether anyone would actually buy it before spending a lot?

questions.label: Financial misinformation
questions.text: A friend says an investment guarantees 3% returns every month with no risk. How can I tell whether it’s legitimate?

questions.label: Housing decision
questions.text: I can afford a down payment, but I might move cities in two years. How should I compare buying with continuing to rent?

questions.label: Family obligations
questions.text: I send money to my parents every month, but I’m falling behind on my own savings. How do I decide what I can sustainably afford?

questions.label: Missing jurisdiction
questions.text: I started freelancing. How much should I set aside for taxes?

questions.label: Consumer product in the AI age
questions.text: I'd like to study how to build a successful SaaS for consumer in the age of AI, and what successful principles of a good products can be drawn from the internet age?

questions.label: Dating uncertainty
questions.text: They’re really affectionate when we meet, but barely reply between dates. Am I asking for too much, or are we looking for different things?

questions.label: Recurring conflict
questions.text: Every time I bring up something that hurt me, my partner says I’m criticizing them. How can we talk without having the same argument?

questions.label: One-sided friendship
questions.text: I’m always the one making plans with my friend. When we meet, it’s lovely, but if I stop texting, nothing happens. Should I say something?

questions.label: Family boundaries
questions.text: My parents expect me to call every day and get upset when I don’t. I love them, but it’s starting to feel like an obligation.

questions.label: Different life plans
questions.text: My partner wants children, and I’m increasingly sure I don’t. We love each other. How do we have an honest conversation about this?

questions.label: Unequal household work
questions.text: My partner says I should just ask when I need help, but I’m tired of managing everything. How do I explain the problem?

questions.label: Repairing trust
questions.text: My partner lied about something important. They’ve apologized, but I keep checking their story. What would rebuilding trust actually involve?

questions.label: Supporting someone grieving
questions.text: My friend’s mother died, and I’m afraid of saying the wrong thing. What can I say or do that would help?

questions.label: Adult loneliness
questions.text: I moved to a new city six months ago. I know people, but I don’t feel close to anyone. How do acquaintances become actual friends?

questions.label: Controlling behavior
questions.text: My partner checks my phone and gets angry when I see friends without them. They say it’s because they care. Is this something we can work through?

questions.label: Unclear direction
questions.text: I don’t know what I want to do with my life. I want stability and time for people I love, but nothing feels like a calling. Where do I start?

questions.label: Achievement without fulfillment
questions.text: I got the promotion I worked toward for years. Nothing is really wrong, but I don’t feel satisfied. How do I figure out what’s missing?

questions.label: Comparison and expectations
questions.text: Most of my friends are buying homes or getting married. I’m not sure I even want those things, but I still feel behind.

questions.label: Losing a sense of self
questions.text: Since becoming a parent, almost everything I do is for someone else. How do I reconnect with myself without feeling selfish?

questions.label: Perfectionism and avoidance
questions.text: I keep researching things I want to do but never start. I’m scared I’ll discover I’m not good at them. How do I break that pattern?

questions.label: Changing beliefs
questions.text: I no longer believe in the religion I grew up with. It used to give my life structure. How do I work out what I believe now?

questions.label: Values in conflict
questions.text: My job pays well, but I’m uncomfortable with what the company sells. How do I tell whether this is a compromise I can live with?

questions.label: Life transition
questions.text: I recently retired and expected to feel free, but I feel unnecessary. How do I build a sense of purpose outside work?

questions.label: Contribution with limits
questions.text: I want to do something useful for my community, but I only have two hours a week. How do I find a contribution that matters?

questions.label: Very little context
questions.text: I feel stuck. I don’t even know what I want to change.

questions.label: Literary interpretation
questions.text: I finished The Little Prince, and it felt beautiful, but I’m not sure I understood why the rose mattered so much. How do you read that relationship?

questions.label: Book discovery
questions.text: I’d like a short, thoughtful novel that leaves me feeling hopeful, but I don’t enjoy obvious life lessons. What might suit me?

questions.label: Geography and causation
questions.text: Why are some places in northern Europe warmer in winter than parts of Canada at similar latitudes?

questions.label: Accessible science
questions.text: How can time pass at different speeds for different people? I’ve heard about relativity, but I can’t picture it.

questions.label: Understanding art
questions.text: I went to a modern-art museum and mostly felt confused. How can I engage with an abstract painting when I don’t know anything about art?

questions.label: Comparing philosophies
questions.text: How would a Stoic and an Epicurean disagree about what makes a good life?

questions.label: Historical oversimplification
questions.text: Were people in medieval Europe really as dirty and ignorant as movies make them seem?

questions.label: Creative ideation
questions.text: I want to write a story about a woman who receives letters from her future self. How can I make the idea feel less predictable?

questions.label: Music and emotion
questions.text: Why does a song in a minor key often sound sad? Is that something everyone hears, or something we learn?

questions.label: Evaluating a new claim
questions.text: I saw a headline saying scientists found signs of life on another planet. Does that mean they actually found living things?
